sec: Minor criteria, echocardiography, TTE vs TEE, TEE indications

items.q: Minor criteria — match the number to the item — 1) 2 2) 3 3) 4 4) 5 … A) Immunological phenomenon B) Fever C) Vascular phenomenon (emboli) D) Microbiological evidence not meeting culture criteria
items.exp: 'minor criteria : 1. Predisposition to IE, 2. Fever, 3. vascular phenomenon (Emboli), 4. Immunological phenomenon, 5. microbiological phenomenon not meeting culture criteria'. (Book p1051)

items.q: Which minor criterion is listed first on this page?
Echocardiography — match the modality to the printed accuracy — 1) TTE 2) TEE … A) Sensitivity 86-98%, specificity 98% B) Sensitivity 50-70%, specificity 86%
items.exp: 'TTE (Transthoracic echocardiography) : Sensitivity 50-70, Specificity 86'; 'TEE (Transesophageal echocardiography) : sensitivity 86-98, specificity 98'. (Book p1051)

items.q: What sensitivity is printed for transthoracic echocardiography?
Which route does the page print for suspected endocarditis with a prosthetic valve or intracardiac device?
items.exp: 'Suspected endocarditis : Native valve → TTE; Prosthetic valve / Intracardiac devices → TEE'. (Book p1051)

items.q: Echo algorithm — match the result to the action — 1) Positive 2) Negative … A) Observe, repeat echo if required B) Rx for endocarditis
items.exp: 'Positive → Rx for endocarditis'; 'Negative → Observe, repeat ECHO if required'. (Book p1051)

items.q: When should TEE be added even if TTE has been done, according to this page?
opts: Only if blood cultures are positive

items.q: TEE indications over TTE — match — 1) Vegetation size 2) Structural complications 3) Devices … A) Myocardial abscess, valve perforation, intracardiac fistula B) CIED (cardiovascular implantable electronic device), prosthetic valve C) Vegetations below 2 mm
items.exp: 'TEE indications over TTE : · vegetations < 2 mm, · myocardial abscess, valve perforation, · Prosthetic valve, · CIED (Cardiovascular implantable electronic device), · Intracardiac fistula'. (Book p1051)

items.q: Which is NOT printed as a TEE indication over TTE?
opts: Uncomplicated native-valve fever with a normal TTE
items.exp: Printed indications: vegetations < 2 mm, myocardial abscess, valve perforation, prosthetic valve, CIED and intracardiac fistula. (Book p1051)
